name: Hornero Color Converter
description: Utility Tools 2.0 color converter: bar quick hex action and compact dashboard detail converting validated #RGB/#RRGGBB to RGB and HSL and RGB back to hex. Invalid hex shows an error.
author: HorneroOS contributors

changelog.notes: Utility Tools 2.0 (plugins#30): bar quick action with popover, compact Utilities dashboard detail panel and a declaration-only launcher entrypoint (not loaded until shell#250) over one tested pure-JS logic block; typed settings default to 1.x behaviour; Spanish catalog.
Dashboard color converter: validated hex to RGB/HSL and RGB inputs back to hex.

defaultHex.description: Hex color pre-filled in the dashboard (#336699, the 1.x initial color).

showPreview.description: Show the color preview swatch in the dashboard (the 1.x behaviour).
